newsitem.title: UK: LME aluminium hovers near 2-year low in late trade.
newsitem.headline: LME aluminium hovers near 2-year low in late trade.

text.p: Aluminium prices on the London Metal Exchange (LME) held just above the two-year low during the evening session on Monday.
By 1800 GMT three months aluminium was quoted at $1,417/$1,420, a couple of dollars above the kerb closing level but still close to the $1,414 low.
The market fell through $1,420 during the afternoon, which traders said was putting prices on course for more significant falls and a test of $1,400 and below in the short term.
A warehouse stock increase has been forecast for Tuesday to keep the pressure on prices.

Copper was also just above kerb closing levels at $1,865/$1,869 but nickel was a little easier at $7,400/$7,420, versus a kerb close of $7,420/$7,430 and only the spreads changed if anything on the other metals.
